simple.meaning: מַתְּנַי (Mattᵉnay) is a Hebrew word meaning “Mattenai , the name of three Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַתְּנַי (H4982) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 10:33, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַתְּנַי (H4982) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַתְּנַי (H4982) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַתְּנַי (Mattᵉnay) / H4982 is traced through Ezra 10:33, Ezra 10:37, Nehemiah 12:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
